notes.title: Patch 1.4 has arrived! Bug fixes and lots of quality of life changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/41e8491c7171e115c6a9c4460491decf9c32e402.png[/img]

[h1]Hiya, fighters![/h1]

Huge thanks to everyone who bought the game, this has been a passion project for years so seeing people having a blast playing it and appreciating all our hard work brings a tear to my eye. [b]Similarly, thank you to everyone who leaves feedback on the forums! We couldn’t have delivered the changes - like this patch - without you![/b]

[h2]Speaking of 1.4 patch - this is a juicy one, and will hopefully elevate Okinawa Rush to the next level! [/h2]

[b]You can read the full changelog below:[/b]

👊 We’ve addressed several issues pertaining to difficulty.
👊 Upon playing the prologue area for the first time, the difficulty will be set to easy (this was an issue if the player chose Arcade mode first).
👊 Mode select screen will now show a timer on Arcade mode and we have revamped the graphics to more clearly communicate that you’re going into hard mode.
👊 We’ve added left/right arrows on the stage select screen to improve clarity.
👊 Sometimes in life you need a helping hand and Okinawa Rush is no different so now when you die, you will receive tips on how to avoid this type of death in the future.
👊 There was a rare issue where Oniboss would sometimes fly through the ceiling while yelling “I must go, my people need me”... or maybe I imagined that last part. Anyway, it’s fixed now.
👊 We’ve improved the flow of 4B (the 2nd cog no longer requires all eggs to be smashed).

Well, that’s it for today’s patch notes. All that’s left is to once again extend a big thank you to everyone who’s played Oki - you rock! We’ll see you next time and remember,

[b]Stay fighting, brave warriors![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/

notes.title: Patch 1.3 featuring keyboard mapping support is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Hiya, fighters![/h1]

[b]We’d like to thank everyone who bought the game, wrote a review, and/ or shared their feedback on the forums - you’re the best.[/b] 

We take your feedback very seriously and any input you can provide matters and helps us make Okinawa Rush better. So far the community support has been breathtaking and We are truly grateful for all the love our game received!

Onto to the main course - [b]We have for you today the patch 1.3! [/b]Among important bug fixes, quality of life changes, and the [b]long-awaited keyboard mapping support[/b], this is a juicy one, and will hopefully elevate Okinawa Rush to the next level! 

You can read the full changelog below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/f2e2b0194463f19491d4209dfc404f58d260044d.png[/img]

👊 A lot of people were very vocally disappointed with the lack of an option to change keyboard mapping so we have worked tirelessly to rectify this problem and give you guys what you want - keyboard mapping for both players. You can now change the mapping by choosing *controls* from the title screen then, in the *devices* page, clicking on the keyboard icon with your mouse.

👊 We have removed the invisible wall from the waterfall in stage 4B. 

👊 Sacrificing weapons for gold at checkpoints didn’t quite work as we wanted it to - that is to say it only worked in the first 2 stages and removed a life each time you tried it. It should now work properly in every stage. To sacrifice your weapons tap *up*, *down* fast then hold *up* at a checkpoint.

👊 One of the nunchakus in stage 1B disappeared when you picked it up. This is now fixed.

👊 You can now use swords to cut the rope on villagers hanging in cages. We watched people try to do this on stream and realized that it should’ve been a thing so now it is.

👊 Yellow “beholders” in Stage 5B weren’t contributing to combos - they do now.

👊 Meditation was a bit hard to figure out for new players so we’ve streamlined it - the weapon drops immediately when you stand on the candle (but you still have to light it). Also, lighting the candle now properly keeps your combo meter in later stages so you can keep your score bonus.

👊 Kickstarter backer RIKUSYOU has now been added as a villager in the Japanese text mode. Previously there was an issue that prevented them from showing.

Well, that’s it for today’s patch notes. All that’s left is to once again extend a big thank you to everyone who’s played Oki - you rock! We’ll see you next time and remember,

[b]stay fighting, brave warriors!
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/fa9515c3ca1012e118cc370ea288736df626253a.png[/img]

[h1]Hiya, fighters![/h1]

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who bought the game, wrote a review, and/ or shared their feedback on the forums. We’re taking all of your words into consideration and the amount of support from the community is astounding! 

Now then, [b]I’m happy to present you with a 1.2 update for Okinawa Rush[/b]. This patch focuses on ironing out small kinks and slightly adjusting the balance. You can read the changelog here:

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
👊 A few of the Kickstarters were missing in the credits; they are now back in. Sorry about that!
👊 We’ve added a new sign in 4B to remind the players to hit the switch if they missed it.
👊 A small balance change to the Mantis Lord. He took way too much damage from the falling lanterns so we’ve given him a bit more lantern resistance. ;)
👊 Editing the dojo just got a bit more pleasant! Before, when editing the dojo, the items would disappear once you switched the locations. This is now fixed and items stay put regardless of the background.
👊 Exit now actually leaves the game on the PC version.

Alright, that’s it for these patch notes. Once again a big thank you to everyone who played OR, you guys rock! See you next time and remember,

[b]stay fighting, brave warriors![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/

notes.title: NextFest, new demo, SPEEDRUN CONTEST, and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/6f6b79027f963cc3d89a40e49411b4761a692dd5.png[/img]

[h1]HIYA Fighters![/h1]

As always thank you all for the feedback! We appreciate each and every comment, so don’t hesitate to leave your impressions and questions under this post or at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/777670/discussions/]forums[/url]. [b]This game wouldn’t be possible to make without the support from the community[/b] so we take every bit of criticism into consideration (and feel honored to hear your praises).

[previewyoutube=HVE5m6mqQHA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A Festive Demo[/h2]
[b]Steam Next Fest is upon us[/b] and so we’ve decided to treat you guys to a new and [b]improved demo of Okinawa Rush[/b]! In this iteration, you get to play through [b]Tutorial, Stage 1, and Master Challenge![/b], where you face off against [b]The Kung-Fu Masters[/b]. The demo will be available until the end of the festival (June 22nd).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/439696f046bb0c29232c1d6b1ed9e08c46fed38c.png[/img]

[h1]Run Like The Wind[/h1]
Hope none of you fighters skipped the leg day! To celebrate Next Fest and the release of our new demo update we’re running a [b]Speedrun Contest[/b]. You can compete in [b]2 categories[/b], and yes, there are prizes. To those unfamiliar with the term, speedrunning is basically trying to beat a game as fast as possible, and that’s what this contest is all about. The game obviously being the Okinawa Rush demo. Why speedrunning? Okinawa Rush is a game perfect for this type of competition, and it even features a built-in timer, so it was really a no-brainer to do this.

[h1]SPEEDRUN CONTEST[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/3c9d4caedd03a12dbf3f346990e666902e7d0f04.jpg[/img]

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]
Players decide which category they want to participate in and record themselves playing through the corresponding stage. The 2 categories are [b]Stage 1[/b] and [b]Master Challenge![/b]. 
[b]TWO IMPORTANT THINGS: [/b]
- In [b]Stage 1 Category[/b] we compete on [b]“Purple Belt”[/b] difficulty, be sure to choose it when you'll launch the stage. In [b]Master Challenge![/b] the difficulty is set to [b]"Black Belt"[/b] by default ;)
- Note that one person cannot win in both categories, so choose wisely, warriors!

[h2]How to submit?[/h2]
Every participant has to upload the video of their run to YouTube and link it in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/777670/discussions/0/3075377162294077302/]the appropriate thread on the Steam forums[/url], marked with their category of choice. The video will enable us to verify your submission.  Deadline is [b]June 22nd, 11:59 PM (CEST)[/b].

We are a small indie developer and the game isn't 100% finished. Please, do not use any bugs you will find in the game to take advantage in this contest. Let's keep the competition clean and fair :) If you've encountered any issues during your run, please let us know!
Also, submissions sent from YT accounts with inappropriate or racist content/nickname won't take part in the contest.

[h2]What are the prizes?[/h2]
👊 [b]A key to Okinawa Rush (the full game)[/b]
👊 [b]Digital Soundtrack[/b]
👊 [b]Digital Artbook[/b]
(all prizes mentioned above will be deliver to both winners on a release day)
👊 [b]AND a special box full of goodies (stickers, t-shirt, poster and soundtrack on CD) for the winner in Master Challenge! Category :D[/b]

[b]Do you have what it takes to blow the competition away?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/900100e9de646c1bb9720301ddb39f2e5c6fd6b9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Be like water, a Stream, to be precise[/h2]
[b]This Friday (June 18th)[/b] we’re doing a Livestream with developers! The stream will take place at  11:00 AM (PT) / 08:00 PM (CEST) - [b]set a reminder![/b]
[list]
[*] Do you have any burning design questions you’ve always wanted to ask? 
[*] Do you have any nice words to pass to the devs? 
[*] Do you have a 12-page document detailing why the position of this one ledge in Stage 1 is breaking the game? 
[/list]
^ If you answered yes to any of these questions, then [b]this is your chance![/b] So grab your popcorn, mark the calendar, cancel all the meetings and enjoy the show.
[b]Be there or be square![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/0d797e858bcb5c764d67a8b68354c89a0d7b685d.png[/img]

That’s it for this update. Are you excited about the new demo? Are you itching to try your hand at the Speedrun Contest? Are you buying a new TV to watch the Livestream on as we speak? [b]Let us know in the comments below![/b] And if you try the demo, please leave us some feedback. We love hearing from you guys and it really helps us make Okinawa Rush a better game.

[b]Till next time, Fighters![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/

notes.title: Okinawa Rush demo - UPDATES!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39980238/0bb7ec1a93f4ebce8d099bffc6925b775a42282e.png[/img]

[h2]HIYA Fighters![/h2]

As you may have noticed - we’re still updating and improving [b]the Okinawa Rush demo[/b]. They’re mostly small upgrades and fixes, but we also managed to sneak in  two major improvements!

Firstly, we got some negative feedback in regards to the [b]jumping mechanic[/b] and we decided to take a closer look at it. Thanks to the latest updates, it’s [b]now more comfortable to control the jumping direction while in the air[/b]. And it makes Okinawa Rush even more fun to play :)

Secondly, we love classic, difficult arcade action games and platformers. But it’s obvious that not all players are into the current incredibly hard gameplay of the demo. So, from now on, [b]when you start the demo, you can choose from various difficulty levels, called ranks[/b] :D

Check out the demo and see for yourself. [b]Do not stop leaving us feedback.[/b] Your opinion has a real influence on Okinawa Rush and will make the game even more excellent at launch!

[b]Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/
